w: During an evening public assembly the balaks performed an impressive dance. A drama, 'Aaj Sudhaare Aavtikaal', lucidly and effectively portrayed the problems facing families today.
The Mayor of Milipitas, Mr. Henry Manayan, praised Swamishri's work in elevating youths. He honored Swamishri by presenting a plaque.

Swamishri blessed the assembly with solutions to family discord. He said, "Today science has advanced immensely. It has given momentum but no direction. Science has provided electricity, yet darkness prevails. The need to illumine our lives has not be fulfilled. There is darkness within. The darkness of failing to understand our family, society, country and culture. To remove that darkness we need to associate with our scriptures and a God realized sadhu."
ph: Mayor of San Jose Ron Gonzalen offering a bouqet to Swamishri on September 16, 2000

w: At 6.00 pm Swamishri flew from Lenasia to Gaborone, and went from the airport to the evening satsang assembly in the mandir.

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj came onto the stage at the shibir (spiritual camp) venue. As part of the shibir, volunteers presented the "Iti Vachanamrutam" symposium before Swamishri. Swamishri was asked various questions. In essence, the questions and answers were:
Question: "When satsang spreads throughout the whole world, how will you give happiness?"

Swamishri: "Behind each sadhu, a hundred thousand people will follow. What Swami said in his talks will come true. There will be one at the head. Then all the others under him. That is how it will be. Everything will be fine. Maharaj and Swami have a master plan. They will do everything. There is no need for us to worry at all."
Swamishri said this quickly, as if he could see it as clearly as an amla fruit in the palm of his hand.
Question: "Please show us a blaze, with a wheel spinning behind and light pouring out. What would it be like?"

Swamishri: "Maharaj and Swami came. They were like elephants, but became ants. Should we make them into elephants again? They behave keeping everything hidden. In a single mukta there is the light of countless suns. If we cannot look at one sun, how could we look at countless suns? Out of great compassion they became like us. They mingled with us.

Maharaj had nothing to do with relatives, but everyone insisted, and he had his relatives called. He showed his Brahmin side. If instead he had shown his divine powers, people would have thought he was a ghost. So Maharaj behaved in our way. Maharaj took birth and became like us, and so we feel happiness. Otherwise, if he showed a blaze, we would not feel happy.

As understanding comes, the light of knowledge will keep spreading. We will come to know what we must do and what we must not do for moksha. The light arises within. We become the servant of servants and understand the glory. The joy in that is not found in a blaze.

Maharaj said, 'We have stopped giving miracles.' Is Maharaj himself coming not a miracle? What would it mean for the President of America to come to the slums of the country? Maharaj did just that! He stayed among us. He became like us. So we should love only Maharaj and Swami. Everything else can lead us astray."
